Question: How important are extracurriculars and awards for someone who wants to get into medical/nursing/radiology? I really don’t plan on going to an Ivy League.
Answer: ….medical/nursing/radiology….. Those are career paths that absorb an Immense amount of your time. If you don’t have some interesting and fun (for you) extracurricular activities, it is going to be a Painful career and many years. You need the support you get from outside activities and the people you do those activities with. Good luck.

Question: Can I get recruited as an international athlete in an ivy league or a T-20 (basketball player) in November of my senior year (suppose I was really good but didn't shine until the senior year)?
Answer: No. Basketball is played (in the USA) from December into March of the following year, and all of the applications to the eight colleges of The Ivy Athletic League are due by January 1st, so no one will know your ability in advance. It is “possible” that one of the eight varsity coaches will learn about your suddenly Awesome capabilities and how you lead your team to the state championship, but that will be After you have applied to the college, and if the coach is impressed they can contact the college’s admissions staff and put in a good word for you. However, you still need to be Ivy League student material so make certain you are in the top Five percent of your graduating class and are considered a great and helpful person with great leadership qualities. Good luck.

Question: What are some online engineering clubs for high schoolers?

Question: Is it a bad sign if someone says "is there anything else" when ending an interview? What could be the reason for saying this?
Answer: No. It just means that the questions they had for you are complete and they are merely asking if You have any other questions or concerns. Good luck.

Question: How can a stealth plane be made without using stealth coating or similar material?
Answer: Two things: Of course, radar is only one means of detection. There also is UV/Visual/IR signature that must be controlled, therefore the coloration of the B-2A, and sound must be minimized and any contrails must be eliminated. Have fun designing your deep-strike attack stealth aircraft.
